item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #3 — May 2026 · Decision-Makers Edition
item.description: May 2026 marks GitHub Copilot's arrival as a measurable enterprise investment. A third consecutive Gartner Leader designation, a major billing model transition, and new metrics that classify every user by AI maturity level — the narrative has shifted from "will AI coding pay off?" to "here's exactly how it is." Enterprise leaders now have the data and the governance controls to tell that story with confidence.

item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #2 — April 2026 · Decision-Makers Edition
item.description: April was a landmark month for enterprise-grade GitHub Copilot: compliance boundaries solidified with data residency and FedRAMP certification, autonomous coding expanded from pull-request creation to full research-and-plan workflows, and two frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic became broadly available. The strategic direction is clear — AI-native software development is ready for regulated, large-scale enterprise adoption.

item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #1 — March 2026 · Decision-Makers Edition
item.description: GitHub Copilot is evolving from a coding assistant into a full agentic platform. This month saw GPT-5.4 go GA, agentic capabilities reach general availability across major IDEs, a new SDK for embedding Copilot into custom applications, and 60 million code reviews — underscoring the scale at which AI is reshaping how software gets built, reviewed, and shipped.
